turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen learned about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, so tell me who decided that and why nobody called me first.
You're welcome. I'm still waiting for an answer.
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about hockey, Hale. Every minute you spend on small talk is one less minute you have before I'm in the principal's office.
What do you do for fun?
I came here to fix my son's mark, not to talk about my weekends. If you can't explain that zero, tell me, and I'll go upstairs now.
